name: YouTube
description: YouTube videos, channels and playlists, played in sync for everyone – in up to 1080p or as audio only, without ads. Sponsor segments are skipped with SponsorBlock.
requires: Internet access from the server. The plugin downloads yt-dlp by itself and keeps it up to date. No YouTube account needed.

settings.label: Topics on the front page
settings.help: A row of videos for each search, separated by commas, e.g. "Avicii, Swedish news, Minecraft".

settings.label: Channels on the front page
settings.help: Channels separated by commas: @name or a youtube.com link. Each gets a row with its latest videos.

settings.label: Playlists on the front page
settings.help: Playlist links separated by commas. Each gets a row; the videos play one after another.

settings.label: Default quality
settings.help: Can be changed in the player's settings while watching.

settings.label: Autoplay
settings.help: When a single video ends, similar videos follow (YouTube's Mix for it). They show in the queue (arrow up in the player).

settings.label: Skip sponsor segments (SponsorBlock)
settings.help: Segments marked by SponsorBlock's users are skipped for everyone.

settings.label: SponsorBlock: what to skip
settings.help: sponsor, selfpromo, interaction ("like and subscribe"), intro, outro, preview, music_offtopic (non-music in music videos).
